g.text: SD03 - Weekly invoice and unpaid-customer follow-up (AD16 / AD18)
Input: customer number; aggregate delivered items per
customer and week, not all items originally ordered.
Read quantityDelivered for actually delivered products
Read per-order discounts agreed with customer (SD01)
order, first-order and customer discount amounts per order
Read documented additional delivery costs, if any
quantity, unit price, line total per delivered item
Aggregate discounts from the delivered orders.
A weekly invoice for two separate EUR 300 orders does
NOT gain 5% order discount merely because EUR 600 is billed.
Do not apply any discount again to the weekly subtotal.
Never invent a Timaflu street address.
draft invoice with itemized calculation and all totals
Review and approve the draft before sending (AD16).
Review outstanding invoices for a customer number (AD18)
Input: customer number; check only this customer's unpaid invoices.
invoice number, paidOn, weeks unpaid, reminders sent
[Fully paid or unpaid for less than one week]
[First unpaid week (at least 7 and under 14 days)]
[Second unpaid week (at least 14 and under 21 days)]
Call customer and offer payment plan
debt collection enabled for the unpaid invoice
Engage debt collection for the unpaid amount
An invoice with active debt collection blocks new orders
for its customer until the full debt has been paid.
Customer.checkOrderBlock() in SD01 READS this state.
It does not itself activate the block.
Do not record partial invoice payments.
Clear the collection block only when ALL outstanding
